label: C2701_V5_FROZEN_ORIGIN
summary_weighting: Flight-weighted pooled loss; also publish equal-month Brier and monthly paired differences.
decision_rule: Treat the transparent baseline as the default. A candidate merits promotion for a target only if it improves the flight-weighted Brier and wins a strict majority of newly acquired core months; use the late September 2026 result as a separate drift check and do not use it to tune.
uncertainty: Paired descriptive comparisons; date dependence, partial selection and external-event uncertainty reported explicitly.
protocol_scope: Forecast origin fixed before each tested month. V4 plan and official file availability were visible; outcome scores in the listed new core and late months were not consulted when freezing. Do not relabel July, October, or January as unseen. Schedules remain reported schedule-field proxies.
